title: What is long context?

body.text: The context window is the total amount of information an AI can 'remember' and process in a single conversation. Claude has a
, which is huge compared to other AIs. One token ≈ 0.75 English words. That means Claude can read and analyze
documents hundreds of pages long in one go

example: "Here's the company's annual report [paste 50 pages]. Summarize the key financial points for me."

title: The benefits of long context

body.text: Long context makes Claude extremely useful for tasks with lots of information — reading and analyzing
contracts, research reports, or an entire project codebase
without trimming anything. Claude remembers everything in the same conversation, including uploaded files, so it can
reference information from the start of the chat even much later on

example: "I've shared the whole codebase. Can you find a bug that might be causing a memory leak in the system?"
